name: FTI Foodtech International Inc.
summary: FTI Foodtech International Inc. engages in the resale of liquidation merchandise. It exchanges goods on barter exchanges for which transactions are tendered using barter exchange dollars. The company also focuses on developing FLASH coins for the barter and food industries. In addition, it engages in the surplus goods business. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Toronto, Canada.
